blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Automatic speech recognition is typically trained assuming that the reference transcript is the only valid labeling of an utterance, yet even nominally verbatim transcripts contain localized differences in pronunciation, spelling, or lexical realization that the acoustics do not uniquely determine. Omni-temporal Classification (OTC) tolerates such noise by adding wildcard paths to the connectionist temporal classification (CTC) alignment graph, but its word-level arcs are too coarse, since bypassing one unsupported token discards supervision for the whole word. We move wildcard arcs to token granularity so unsupported tokens can be bypassed while the rest of the word stays supervised, and we combine token- and word-level arcs as complementary escape paths. Across 19 languages and three corpora, token-level OTC improves over CTC on all 25 tasks. We also replace epoch-indexed relaxation of the wildcard weights with a predictive-entropy-indexed schedule, which performs comparably while reducing dependence on training length. Combining this schedule with the hybrid graph gives the lowest mean word error rate (WER) on every corpus and a 9.45% average relative WER reduction over CTC. Independent validator transcriptions show that token-level models place significantly more wildcard-bypass probability than CTC on disputed characters, indicating that token-level tolerance targets localized transcript ambiguity.
blocks.zh: 自动语音识别一般是经过训练的,假设参考语录是语音唯一有效的标签,但即使是名义上的逐字记录都包含发音,拼写,或词典性认知的局部差异,声学并不独有地决定. Omni-时态分类(OTC)通过在连接论时态分类(CTC)对齐图中加入通配符路径来容忍这种噪声,但其词层弧度太粗糙,因为绕过一个无支持的令牌会丢弃整个词的监督. 我们把通配符弧移到标点颗粒度上,这样在其余的字段保持监控时,不支持的符号就可以被绕过,我们把标点符弧和词级弧作为互补的逃生路径进行组合. 在19种语言和3个公司中,信使级的OTC在所有25项任务上都比反恐委员会有所改进。 我们还用一个预测-内向-索引时间表来取代划时代索引的对通配符加权的放松,该时间表在减少对训练时间的依赖的同时具有可比性。 将这个表与混合图结合起来,可以得出每个实体的平均字数误差率最低,比CTC平均比WER减少9.4%. 独立验证员的抄录显示,信使级模型对争议字符的通配符概率比CTC大得多,表明信使级容忍度目标为本地化的抄录符模糊.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: End-to-end automatic speech recognition (ASR) models trained with connectionist temporal classification (CTC) [ 10 ] sum over alignments that collapse to a single reference transcript, treating it as the only valid labeling. Yet even verbatim transcripts contain choices the acoustics do not settle, such as spelling variants, vowel-length or nasalization marks in Indic scripts, or inflections reduced in fast speech. Annotators often disagree on one or two characters of a word while agreeing on the rest, which ASR evaluation increasingly accounts for through multiple references or permissible spelling variants [ 1 , 18 , 4 ] . CTC training, however, still supervises every position as if the reference were certain, pushing the model toward labels the audio may not support.
blocks.zh: 端到端的自动语音识别(ASR)模型经过连接器时间分类(CTC)[10]总和,超过折叠为单一参考记录的对齐,将其视为唯一有效的标签. 然而,即使是逐字记录都包含着声学没有解决的选择,例如拼音变体,元音长或音节化印记在Indic脚本中,或者在快速语音中缩小的缩写. 注释者在商定其余内容的同时往往对一个单词的一个或两个字符有不同意见,ASR评价越来越多地通过多处引用或允许的拼写变体[1,18,4]来说明这一点. 然而,反恐委员会的培训仍然监督每个位置,似乎参考文献是肯定的,将模型推向音频的标签可能不支持。

blocks.en: Error-tolerant objectives for CTC and transducers [ 11 , 17 , 7 ] address several kinds of label noise. STC [ 23 ] and W-CTC [ 5 ] handle missing parts of the transcript, graph-based temporal classification [ 20 ] and alternative pseudo-labeling [ 26 ] handle uncertain pseudo-labels, and token-weighted RNN-T [ 14 ] down-weights unreliable tokens. Bypass temporal classification [ 8 ] and its extension, Omni-temporal Classification (OTC) [ 9 ] , add a wildcard ⋆ \star to the weighted finite-state transducer (WFST) alignment graph [ 19 , 13 ] , whose bypass arcs skip unsupported transcript units and self-loops absorb unexplained frames; similar arcs between adjacent tokens also make keyword spotting robust to noise [ 25 ] . These methods mostly target heavy label corruption or acoustic noise, whereas we focus on verbatim transcripts, where the reference is largely correct and disagreement is sparse and local.
blocks.zh: 四氯化碳和转录器的耐错误目标[11、17、7]涉及几种标签噪音。 STC [23]和W-CTC [5] 处理笔录中缺失的部分,基于图表的时间分类 [20] 和替代伪标签 [26] 处理不确定的伪标签,以及象征加权的RNN-T [14] 下重不可靠的符号. 附带时间分类[8]及其扩展,Omni-temporal Classion(OTC)[9],在加权有限状态转录器(WFST)对齐图中添加一个通配符QQ\star[19,13],其绕弧跳过无支持的转录单元,自转录器吸收了无法解释的帧;相邻信号之间的类似弧也使得关键词的显示强烈到噪音[25]. 这些方法主要针对沉重的标签腐败或声响,而我们则侧重于逐字记录稿,其中的参考基本正确,分歧很少,而且地方上也很少。

blocks.en: Published OTC uses word-level arcs with weights tuned on transcripts containing 50% simulated errors and performs similarly to CTC on verbatim data [ 9 ] . To our knowledge, no OTC-related work reports a gain over CTC on verbatim LibriSpeech. Re-tuning the weights on clean speech helps only slightly since skipping one unsupported token still discards supervision for the whole word. We therefore place wildcard arcs at the token level so that a local deviation can be bypassed while the remaining tokens stay supervised, and we add word-level bypasses as a second escape path for wholly unsupported words. We also relax the wildcard weights by using held-out predictive entropy rather than epoch count to reduce dependence on training length.
blocks.zh: 已出版的OTC使用带有权重的字面弧调用包含50%模拟误差的文字记录,并在逐字记录数据方面与CTC类似[9]. 据我们所知,没有任何与东方木材公司有关的工作报告比反恐委员会在LibriSpeech逐字记录方面有所收获。 由于跳过一个无支持的符号仍然丢弃整个词的监管,重新调整干净的语音上的权重只会有一点帮助. 因此,我们将通配符弧放在符位上,以便在剩余符位保持监控时可以绕过局部偏差,我们添加字位绕行作为完全不支持的词的第二个逃生路径. 我们还通过使用搁置的预测性肽而不是划时代的计数来减少对训练长度的依赖,来放松通配符重量.

blocks.en: WER gains alone do not show that this tolerance is used where transcripts are actually ambiguous. We therefore obtained independent transcriptions of the RESPIN [ 16 ] development and test sets, for which only a single reference is released, from three external validation vendors. Disputed characters and words receive substantially more bypass probability than agreed ones, and token-level models assign significantly more of it than CTC to disputed characters while leaving agreed characters nearly unchanged. This indicates that token-level tolerance is associated with localised transcript ambiguity rather than an indiscriminate relaxation of the objective.
blocks.zh: 单凭WER收益并不能表明这种容忍性在文字记录实际上模棱两可的情况下被使用. 因此,我们从三个外部验证供应商处获得了RESPIN[16]开发和测试集的独立抄录本,只有一份参考。 争议字符和词的绕行概率大大高于商定字符和词的绕行概率,象征级模型为争议字符分配的比CTC多得多,而商定字符几乎保持不变。 这表明,象征性的容忍与地方化的文字记录模糊有关,而不是不加区别地放松目标。

blocks.en: Our contributions can be summarised as follows. • Token-level wildcard arcs for OTC-based ASR training, which improve WER over CTC on all 25 tasks across 19 languages and three corpora, whereas existing word-level OTC performs similarly to CTC on LibriSpeech and RESPIN. • A hybrid graph combining token- and word-level bypasses, trained with an entropy-indexed relaxation schedule, which gives the lowest mean WER on every corpus and a 9.45% average relative reduction over CTC. • An analysis based on independent validator transcriptions of RESPIN, showing that token-level models become more tolerant specifically at characters where annotators disagree, which links the added tolerance to genuine transcript ambiguity in verbatim data. 1 1 1 Code and configurations are available at https://github.com/saurabhk0317/wsasr_icassp27.git .
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献可归纳如下。 • 基于OTC的ASR培训的Token-level通配符弧,在19种语言和3个公司的所有25项任务上比CTC改进WER,而现有的单词级OTC在LibriSpeech和RESPIN方面则与CTC相似。 • 混合图,将符号和词级绕行结合起来,经过培训后,采用肽指数式的放松时间表,使每个实体的平均WER值最低,比四氯化碳的平均相对减少9.4%。 基于RESPIN的独立验证者抄录的分析显示,对注释者有不同意见的人物来说,象征级模型变得更加宽容,这把附加的容忍度与逐字记录中的真实抄录模棱两可联系起来。 1 1 1 代码和配置见https://github.com/saurabhk0317/wsasr_icassp27.git.

blocks.zh: 用于基于OTC的ASR培训的顶级通配符弧,在19种语言和3种公司的所有25项任务上比CTC改进WER,而现有的单词级OTC在LibriSpeech和RESPIN上则与CTC相似。

blocks.en: 3.1 Arc granularity
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 弧颗粒

blocks.en: We target localized transcript variation, where a word differs from the acoustics in only one or a few tokens because of pronunciation, spelling, or inflectional variation, which motivates placing wildcard arcs at token rather than word granularity. Whereas the published OTC-W e formulation treats each word as one unit, OTC-T e sets K = U K=U , placing a bypass arc between every pair of consecutive tokens and a self-loop at every state (Fig. 1 c); word boundaries are obtained from the SentencePiece word-start marker for BPE units and from the space symbol for character units.
blocks.zh: 我们的目标是本地化的音符变异,即一个单词由于发音,拼写,或者不动的变异而与音符中的音符相异,这激发了将通卡弧置于符符而非单词颗粒性. 已出版的OTC-W e配方将每个单词作为一个单位处理,而OTC-T e设置 K = U K=U,在每个连续的每对令牌和每个状态的自旋(图1c)之间设置一个绕弧;从BPE单位的PriedPiece词首标记和字符单位的空间符号中获取词首边界.

blocks.en: Token-level arcs provide finer resolution and retain supervision: a single unsupported token can be bypassed without skipping the whole word, leaving the remaining tokens on the alignment path. They also make the escape cost less dependent on word length, since OTC-W replaces all n n token emissions of a bypassed word with one ⋆ \star at a fixed penalty, whereas token-level arcs incur a cost that scales with the number of bypassed tokens. The two are therefore complementary: a wholly unsupported word can be handled by one word-level bypass, and a partially unsupported word by token-level bypasses. We combine both in OTC-TW, which adds one word bypass arc per word to the token-level graph (Fig. 1 d). The self-loop absorbs extra audio frames and doesn’t need a separate word-level version because the token-level self-loop can already absorb any number of frames.
blocks.zh: Token-level 弧提供更精细的解析度并保留监督:一个单一的不支持的代号可以绕过而不跳过整个单词,将剩余的代号留在对齐路径上. 它们也使得逃逸成本较少依赖于词长,因为OTC-W将一个绕行词的所有n符号排放替换为一个 \\\ star 在固定的处罚下,而象征级弧则产生一个成本,按照绕行符的数量进行比例化. 因此两者是互补的:一个完全不支持的单词可以由一个单词级绕行处理,一个部分不支持的单词可以由符号级绕行处理. 我们在OTC-TW中将两者结合起来,在符号级图(图1d)中每字增加一个字绕行弧. 自动启动可以吸收额外的音频帧, 不需要单独的单词级版本, 因为自动启动可以吸收任意数量的帧 。

4 Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 4 实验和结果

blocks.en: We evaluate our methods on 19 languages from LibriSpeech [ 21 ] , FLEURS [ 6 ] , and RESPIN [ 16 ] . LibriSpeech uses train-clean-100 for training, dev-clean/other for validation, and test-clean/other for evaluation. FLEURS covers 14 languages across four families, 14 scripts, and diverse morphological types using the published splits. RESPIN uses the official dev/test sets and a 30-hour subset of train_<lang>_small , restricted to unique sentences. Language codes are listed in Table 2 .
blocks.zh: 我们从LibriSpeech[21]、FLEURS[6]和RESPIN[16]等19种语言评估我们的方法。 LibriSpeech将列车-清洁-100用于培训,dev-clean/其他用于验证,测试-清洁/其他用于评价. FLEURS涵盖4个家族的14种语言,14种脚本,以及使用已公布的分词的多种形态类型. RESPIN使用官方的dev/测试集和30小时的列车子集,限定为独特的句子. 语言编码见表2。

blocks.en: All systems use a 12-block E-Branchformer encoder [ 15 ] ( d = 256 d=256 , four heads) in ESPnet2 [ 24 ] , with WFST losses computed in k2. RESPIN uses 80-dimensional filterbanks for 70 epochs, while FLEURS and LibriSpeech use frozen XLS-R 300M [ 2 ] and wav2vec 2.0 Base features [ 3 ] , respectively, followed by linear projection and 30 epochs. FLEURS/RESPIN use character units, while LibriSpeech uses 200 BPE units. All systems apply SpecAugment [ 22 ] , three-way speed perturbation, Adam with warmup, and validation-loss checkpoint averaging; only the loss function varies within each corpus. Decoding uses CTC prefix search without an external language model, and we report WER. To test whether the results depend on the encoder, we repeat the LibriSpeech experiments with a 12-block Conformer [ 12 ] of the same width and head count, changing only the encoder and adding early stopping (patience 5).
blocks.zh: 所有系统在ESPnet2 [24]中使用12块E-Branchformer编码器[15](d = 256 d = 256,4个头),WFST损失以k2计算. RESPIN对70个纪元使用80维滤波库,而FLEURS和LibriSpeech分别使用冷冻的XLS-R 300M [2]和wav2vec 2.0 碱性特性[3],之后是线性投影和30个纪元. FLEURS/RESPIN使用字符单元,LibriSpeech则使用200个BPE单元. 所有系统都采用SpecAugment [22],三程速度扰动,亚当加热,验证-损失检查点平均;只有损失功能在每种器件内有所不同. 解码使用没有外部语言模型的CTC前缀搜索,我们报告WER. 为了测试结果是否取决于编码器,我们重复LibriSpeech实验,采用12块的Conformer[12],宽度和头数相同,只更改编码器,并添加早期停止(patience 5).

Table 2 compares the seven criteria on the 25 tasks. With the published settings, OTC-W e has a slightly higher mean WER than CTC on LibriSpeech and RESPIN, and five runs required a larger bypass penalty to avoid divergence. 2 2 2 This matches the near-parity with CTC on LibriSpeech clean data reported in [ 9 ] . Absolute WERs are not directly comparable due to different toolkits and front-ends. Re-tuning on clean speech (OTC-W ′ e {}^{\prime}_{e} ) removes the divergence, but the average gain is small and does not carry over to RESPIN. Word-level arcs therefore remain limited on verbatim transcripts, since bypassing one token skips the whole word.
blocks.zh: 表2比较了25项任务的七项标准。 有了已公布的设置,OTC-W e在LibriSpeech和RESPIN上的平均WER略高于CTC,5次运行需要更大的绕行处罚以避免分歧. 2个 2个 2 这与在[9]中报告的 LibriSpeech 清洁数据方面与四氯化碳的近似均等一致。 绝对 由于工具包和前端不同,WER没有直接可比性. 重新调整干净的语音(OTC-W ' e {}^{\prime}_{e})可以消除分歧,但平均收益很小,不会结转到RESPIN. 因此,文字层面的弧度仍然限于逐字记录,因为绕过一个符号跳过整个字。

blocks.en: Token-level tolerance gives a substantially different result. Both OTC-T e and entropy-indexed OTC-T H improve over CTC on all 25 tasks without per-language tuning. Their similar performance across all three corpora also shows that the gain is not specific to the choice of epoch- or entropy-indexed decay. The consistent gains support our hypothesis that allowing individual unsupported tokens to be bypassed is better suited to localised transcript variation than bypassing whole words. These comparisons also bound how much of the gain can be attributed to generic relaxation of the objective. OTC-W e and OTC-W ′ e {}_{e}^{\prime} add wildcard escapes to the same objective, the latter with weights re-tuned on clean speech, yet every token-level criterion has a lower mean WER than both of them on all three corpora, and OTC-W e is worse than CTC on two. Relaxing the alignment constraint is therefore not sufficient on its own; what separates the criteria is where the escape is placed, which Sec. 4.4 examines directly.
blocks.zh: 洞层容忍产生的结果大不相同。 OTC-T e和Entropy索引的OTC-T H在所有25项任务上都改进了CTC,没有每个语言的调音. 它们在所有三个蝎子身上的类似性能也表明,增益并不特指选用oc-或entropy-index衰变. 一致的收益支持了我们的假设,即允许绕过个别无支持的符号比绕过整个字词更适合本地化的笔录变化. 这些比较还决定了在多大程度上收益可以归因于目标的普遍放松。 OTC-W e和 OTC-W e e e e e }^{\prime )在同一个目标上加入通配符逃逸,后者在干净的语音上重调重量,然而每个符号级标准在三个蝎子上都有一个较低的平均WER,而OTC-W e在两个上都比CTC差. 因此,放松对齐的制约本身并不足够;标准的不同之处在于越狱地点,第4.4节直接审查。

blocks.en: The combined graph further shows that the two granularities are complementary. OTC-TW e improves over the token-only and word-only criteria on LibriSpeech and FLEURS, but its epoch-indexed relaxation degrades on RESPIN, falling 0.24% below CTC on average, the same failure mode seen in OTC-W e and OTC-W ′ e {}_{e}^{\prime} . Replacing the epoch index with predictive entropy in OTC-TW H removes this degradation: it gives the lowest mean WER on all three corpora and, at 9.45% relative, the largest average reduction over CTC of any criterion in Table 2 , ahead of OTC-T e (8.46%) and OTC-T H (7.67%). It also has the lowest WER on 9 of the 25 individual tasks, more than any other single criterion.
blocks.zh: 综合图进一步表明,这两个颗粒是互补的。 OTC-TW e在LibriSpeech和FLEURS上改进了仅标语和单词标准,但其划时代索引的放松在RESPIN上下降,平均比CTC低0.24%,与OTC-W e和OTC-W ' e e e e }^{\prime}中相同的失败模式. 在OTC-TW H中,用预测的 en取代时代指数可以消除这种降解:它使所有三体的平均WER值最低,相对而言,比表2中的任何标准比四氯化碳平均减少9.4%,比OTC-T e(8.46%)和OTC-T H(7.67%)最高。 它在25个单独任务中的9个任务上也拥有最低的WER,比任何其他单一标准都要多.

blocks.en: Table 3 repeats the LibriSpeech comparison with the Conformer encoder. The ranking of Table 2 is reproduced exactly except that OTC-W e and CTC exchange places, indicating that the benefit of token-level tolerance is not specific to the E-Branchformer.
blocks.zh: 表3重复了LibriSpeech与Conformer编码器的比较. 表2的排名完全照搬,但OTC-W e和CTC的交换位置除外,表明象征级容忍的好处并非特指E-Branchformer.

blocks.en: RESPIN releases one reference transcript per utterance [ 16 ] ; we additionally obtained three independent transcriptions of its dev and test sets from external validation vendors (in-house, not yet public). Aligning each validator transcript to the reference at the character level, we call a character or word disputed when at least one validator changes it and the validators do not all propose the same alternative, since a unanimous correction indicates an erroneous rather than an ambiguous reference.
blocks.zh: RESPIN每句话发布一份参考记录[16];我们从外部验证供应商(内部,尚未公开)另外获得了三份独立记录的编印和测试集。 将每个验证员的笔录与字符级的引用对齐,当至少有一个验证员更改时,我们称一个字符或词有争议,验证员并不都提出相同的替代方案,因为一致的更正表明一个错误而非模糊的引用.

blocks.en: Every system, CTC included, places an order of magnitude more bypass probability on disputed than on agreed characters ( 11 × 11\times for CTC), and the amount rises with the number of dissenting validators (Table 4 ). Token-level arcs raise the disputed-character mean by 27 27 – 36 % 36\% over CTC, with the combined criteria behaving alike, while agreed characters are essentially unchanged; the gain holds in all nine languages on both splits and is significant under a paired bootstrap over utterances ( 10 000 10\,000 resamples, p < 0.001 p<0.001 ).
blocks.zh: 包括反恐委员会在内的每个系统对有争议的字符的绕行概率都比商定字符的绕行概率高(反恐委员会为11x11x次),而且数额随着持不同意见的验证者的数目而增加(表4)。 Token-level 弧向CTC提升了27 27 — 36 % 36 — — 高于CTC, 综合标准行为相同,而商定的字符基本不变;在两种语言的分割上,所有9种语言的增益都存在,在对齐的靴子圈子下,这些增益是重大的(10 000 10\ 000 resamples, p < 0.001 p < 0.001))。

blocks.en: Word-level values are far smaller, and the criteria carrying word arcs raise agreed words as much as disputed ones, so their higher disputed means reflect a uniform increase rather than selectivity. We do not read much into these differences, since a whole word is rarely unsupported in verbatim transcripts, where half of all disputed words differ in a single character of an average 4.8 4.8 and a third only by an insertion. This plausibly explains why word-level arcs help little here: a word bypass must discard supervision for the remaining characters to absorb a disagreement that a token arc handles far more cheaply, the mechanism hypothesised in Sec. 3.1 .
blocks.zh: 词层值要小得多,带词弧的标准会像有争议词一样提出商定的词,因此其较高的争议手段反映了统一的增加而不是选择性. 我们对这些差异没有作多少理解,因为整个词很少在逐字记录中得不到支持,其中半数有争议的词的单一性质不同,平均4.8,三分之一只有插入。 这很合理地解释了为什么单词级弧线在这里帮助不大:一个单词绕行必须丢弃对剩余字符的监管,以吸收一种分歧,即一个符号级弧线可以更便宜地处理,这个机制假设在Sec. 3.1中.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Moving OTC’s wildcard arcs from words to tokens lets an unsupported token be bypassed while the rest of the word stays supervised. With one setting for all corpora, token-level OTC improved over CTC on all 25 tasks, whereas published word-level OTC stayed close to CTC on LibriSpeech and RESPIN; the trends held with a Conformer encoder. Combining token- and word-level bypasses with entropy-indexed decay gave the lowest mean WER on every corpus, a 9.45 % 9.45\% average relative reduction over CTC, and avoided the RESPIN degradation of its epoch-indexed counterpart. Validator transcriptions show that disagreement is local, usually a single character or an inserted space, and token-level models assign more bypass probability to disputed characters while leaving agreed ones essentially unchanged. In future work, we will aim to learn the wildcard weights instead of scheduling them and evaluate against multiple references.
blocks.zh: 将 OTC 的通配符弧从单词移到符号上, 让一个不支持的符号被绕过, 在所有公司都有一个设置,象征级的OTC在所有25项任务上都比CTC有所改进,而公布的字级OTC则在LibriSpeech和RESPIN上与CTC保持密切;趋势是使用Conformer编码器。 将符号级和词级绕行与肽指数衰减相结合,使每个实体的平均WER值最低,比CTC平均相对减少9.45 % 94.5%,并避免了RESPIN的划时代索引对应物的退化. 校验器的抄录显示,分歧是局部的,通常是单个字符或插入的空间,而信使级模型为有争议的字符分配更多的绕行概率,同时让商定的字符基本不变. 在今后的工作中,我们将努力学习通配符加权数,而不是安排时间,并根据多种参考标准进行评估。
